gaps.title: Missing GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows (build/test/lint gates)
gaps.description: The repo has no .github/workflows/* workflows to automate backend and frontend build/test/lint.

gaps.title: No Docker/Docker Compose for reproducible local run and deployment
gaps.description: There is no Dockerfile/docker-compose to run backend + frontend together in a standardized environment.

gaps.title: No application health endpoints (Actuator) for observability
gaps.description: Backend doesn't include Spring Boot Actuator, so there are no /actuator/health or metrics endpoints.

gaps.title: Missing CORS configuration for non-proxied frontend deployments
gaps.description: Backend doesn't explicitly configure CORS. Production frontend/API on different domains may fail with browser CORS errors.

gaps.title: No authentication/authorization (all Todos are public)
gaps.description: API exposes full CRUD endpoints without user context. Suitable for single-user demo, however risky if publicly deployed and harder to extend to multi-user.

gaps.title: Frontend has no unit/component tests
gaps.description: The frontend setup contains no test runner (vitest/jest) or test scripts.

gaps.title: Backend test coverage is minimal (only basic controller tests)
gaps.description: Backend tests exist but don't comprehensively cover repository/service layer and error scenarios.

gaps.title: No API contract documentation (OpenAPI/ Swagger)
gaps.description: The API is documented in README but there is no machine-readable contract (OpenAPI spec) or Swagger UI.

gaps.title: No environment config strategy (profiles, env vars)
gaps.description: Backend uses a hard-coded SQLite path ("./data/todo.db") in application.yml without clear profiles/override docs.

gaps.title: Obsolete gap-analysis-state.json artifact present
gaps.description: Repo contains docs/sdlc/handoff/gap-analysis-state.json, but the workflow requires gap-analysis-handoff.json as authoritative. It also has inconsistent metadata/counts.
